text:
maria: Holding off on unpinning runtime v2.15 in eu-west for the night. Seeing intermittent mid-stream truncation on longseq workloads, want to avoid user regressions. tagging @deploybot for current pin status.

deploybot: deploybot: pinlist snapshot saved (1719456700). runtime v2.15 pinned in eu-west. Reason: kvcache-incompat truncation observed. CI: 8/10 green. report: https://deploy/reports/1719456700

neil: Is this the same symptom as last week's longseq truncation? any stack traces or error ids?

maria: Not OOM this time — responses cut off mid-token. Example log: `2026-03-23T01:46:12Z llr: decode_cursor_reset -> client_stream_end` (short snippet). More logs in S3: s3://redwood-logs/infra/runtime/1719456700/truncation.log

sre_alex: Saw a bump in 5xxs for api-prod-eu on 2.15 around 01:40 UTC. My vote is avoid an immediate rollback unless we need to — soft-unpin (route new canary traffic off 2.15) first.

sam: Soft-unpin will change latency mix for canary users. How fast can routing switch happen?

maria: Routing change is fast (~1-2min) if we update the canary policy. Option A: route canary -> 2.14.3, keep pin for prod. Option B: keep pin for everything and schedule hotfix. Need decision.

lia: Hotfix required: kernel guard to stabilize KV cache pointers. Estimate 4-6 hours for patch + QA. Prefer holding the pin through the night and deploy hotfix at 06:00 UTC.

maria: Proposed plan: hold current pin through night, schedule hotfix deploy at 06:00 UTC, after deploy do soft-unpin with 30m telemetry watch. If truncated-seqs >5% in that window, auto-rollback.

neil: +1. Add an alert: truncated-seq-rate >5% within 30m => trigger rollback to 2.14.3. Also watch client_error_rate >2%.

deploybot: scheduled: hotfix window set for 1719492000 (2026-03-23 06:00 UTC). Rollback command (manual): `/deploybot rollback runtime v2.15 eu-west` — will restore v2.14.3. Can also run `/deploybot soft-unpin runtime v2.15 route=2.14.3 canary=true`.

sre_alex: I'll create runbook bullets and attach pager for the window. Runbook snippet: 
``
If truncated_seq_rate > 5% -> run `/deploybot rollback runtime v2.15 eu-west`
If client_error_rate > 2% -> escalate to oncall
``

maria: Also want to pin SDK to avoid signature mismatch during rollout. Recommend SDK 3.2.1 pinned for canary + prod until hotfix lands.

lia: SDK 3.2.1 OK. I'll open PR for the shim and request quick QA — ETA ~2h.

sam: DevEx: please prepare short note for customers who are pinned to older runtimes explaining why routing change might affect latency.

maria: Thanks all. Locking this thread for ops tonight. I'll post a follow-up after the 06:00 hotfix and the 30m watch. ping me if any alerts fire. /cc @deploybot :thumbsup:
